summary: Ukraine has conducted significant strikes against Russian infrastructure, including an oil depot in the Moscow region and a merchant vessel in the Black Sea. Concurrently, Russia has launched drone and missile attacks targeting multiple Ukrainian regions and port infrastructure. Internal political instability is rising in Ukraine due to widespread protests demanding the resignation of Commander-in-Chief Syrsky.
key_points: Ukrainian forces struck an oil depot in the Moscow region and the 'Svetlyak' patrol ship in Kerch (Source: @UkraineNow/82745).
Russia launched a large-scale drone attack on Moscow, Leningrad, and Moscow regions, targeting a Wildberries logistics center (Source: @UkraineNow/82738).
The Russian Ministry of Defense reported strikes on military cargo ships and fuel storage in the Port of Yuzhny (Source: @tass_agency/385883).
Ukrainian drone strikes on Russian oil refineries have caused a sharp surge in diesel prices in the United States (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31723).
Widespread protests are occurring across Ukraine, including Kyiv and Lviv, demanding the resignation of Commander-in-Chief Syrsky (Source: @DeepStateUA/23660).
Russia reported strikes on fuel and transport infrastructure used by the Ukrainian Armed Forces (Source: @tass_agency/385848).
A Ukrainian drone strike in the northern part of Crimea resulted in two deaths and one injury (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/3721).
The Russian Ministry of Defense released footage of an attack on a container ship in the Black Sea using Geran-4 Shikher and Gerbera-Shikher drones (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31722).

Russia launched X-31P missiles targeting Odesa, Pivdenne, and Chornomorsk (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69132).

sections.threat_assessment: The operational environment is highly volatile due to simultaneous strikes on critical infrastructure in both Russia and Ukraine. The targeting of Russian oil depots and logistics hubs indicates a sustained effort to disrupt Russian economic and military capacity. Concurrently, Russian drone and missile strikes against Ukrainian cities and ports continue to pose a significant threat to civilian and military logistics.
sections.regional_response: Ukraine is experiencing significant internal political pressure, with large-scale protests demanding leadership changes in the military. This domestic instability coincides with intense aerial warfare and strikes on maritime infrastructure in the Black Sea. The international community's ability to sustain aid is noted as a potential future constraint for Ukraine.
sections.intelligence_notes: The use of specialized jet drones and advanced UAVs like 'Geran-4 Shikher' is increasing in both directions. The economic impact of Ukrainian strikes on Russian refineries is manifesting in global energy markets, specifically US diesel prices. Political instability in Ukraine, characterized by protests against the military command, represents a growing internal security concern.
